newsitem.title: BULGARIA: KOREAN DAEWOO LAUNCHES BULGARIA SUBSIDIARY.
newsitem.headline: KOREAN DAEWOO LAUNCHES BULGARIA SUBSIDIARY.

text.p: South Korea's giant Daewoo Corp said on Thursday it had launched a subsidiary in Bulgaria in a move to step up its activities in this Balkan country.

"Daewoo Corp is setting up Daewoo Bulgaria AD as a part of its strategy for expansion in this country," the representative of Daewoo's Sofia branch office Chung-Hwan Kim told reporters at the official launch.
"We are interested in Bulgaria's banking sector, chemical industry, telecommunications, machine building and tourism."
Young-Kwan Kwon, managing director of Daewoo Bulgaria AD, said the conglomerate planned to produce forklift trucks in Bulgaria.
"We are going to hold talks with Bulgarian officials on buying a stake in the state-owned forklift truck producer Balkankar Holding or setting up a joint venture", Kwon said.
He said Daewoo's long-term projects in the country also included production of spare parts for cars and their export to third countries.

Daewoo's investment plans come at a time when the debt-ridden Balkan country is battling severe economic crisis. International lenders have criticised the Socialist government for not doing enough to encourage foreign investment and for delaying the privatisation process.

"The economic situation in Bulgaria is unstable and not quite clear... Nevertheless, we are committed to stepping up our activities here... We will be happy to contribute to the country' s economic reforms," Kim said.
Asked how much Daewoo planned to invest in Bulgaria, Kim said the company had set no particular limit for its investments and they would depend on the exact enterprises which were developed.
Daewoo Corp established a branch in Bulgaria in 1992. Last month, it bought a 67-percent stake in the Sheraton Sofia Hotel Balkan and pledged to invest some $5 million in it over the next five years.
"We shall invest additionally $5 to $10 million in the hotel for building of a car park in front of the hotel," Kim said.
